## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX neutral: VXX (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +4.95%) CORRECTION and SPY (1W: +0.84% | 1M: -0.46%) RECOVERY show mixed risk signals, confirming a flat/transition environment.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Commodity and energy strength: XLE (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +18.64%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +10.63%) ABOVE TREND driving cyclical reflation. Credit flows steady: HYG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.23%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +0.54%) ABOVE TREND — HYG/LQD rising → credit stress easing; but fear is mixed via VXX (see above).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-supportive: TLT (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND while SPY (1W: +0.84% | 1M: -0.46%) RECOVERY keeps SPY/TLT effectively neutral. Dollar and curve metrics are flat in the data, so financial conditions are not signaling a clear tightening or loosening.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Cyclicals and commodities leading: XLB (1W: +3.33% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +18.64%) ABOVE TREND showing breadth. Tech ETF mixed vs sector breadth: XLK (1W: +3.51% | 1M: -2.60%) RECOVERY while Technology (sector breadth: 1W: -0.24% | 1M: -7.31%) is negative — style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?  
Emerging markets and Japan outperforming: EEM (1W: +4.69% | 1M: +6.25%) ABOVE TREND and EWJ (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +10.18%) ABOVE TREND. US large cap mixed: SPY (1W: +0.84% | 1M: -0.46%) RECOVERY, China FXI (1W: +3.14% | 1M: -2.88%) RECOVERY — global breadth supportive.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Mixed/speculative risk cooling: IWM (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +1.32%) ABOVE TREND shows small‑cap appetite, while IBIT (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -26.18%) BELOW TREND and ETHA (1W: -9.73% | 1M: -37.07%) BELOW TREND indicate crypto/speculative drawdown; ARKK (1W: +1.26% | 1M: -14.14%) RECOVERY remains weak.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Bifurcated: GLD (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +10.75%) ABOVE TREND and base metals CPER (1W: +1.41% | 1M: -0.22%) RECOVERY showing inflow into safe-haven and industrial metals, while SLV (1W: -3.31% | 1M: -0.87%) BELOW TREND and UNG (1W: -8.47% | 1M: +10.20%) CORRECTION remain volatile.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy leadership intact: XLE (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +18.64%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +10.63%) ABOVE TREND — sector strength is a key market driver; UNG (1W: -8.47% | 1M: +10.20%) CORRECTION highlights nat‑gas volatility.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Energy (XLE both timeframes positive) and commodities (GLD both timeframes positive) provide twin confirmations of cyclical/commodity leadership. DIVERGENCE: SPY and XLK show 1W vs 1M mismatch (both RECOVERY with negative 1M), and crypto ETFs (IBIT/ETHA) are clear weaknesses — overall a MINOR divergence environment but worth monitoring.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor cyclical/resource exposure via XLE (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +18.64%) ABOVE TREND and XLB (1W: +3.33% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to crypto ETFs IBIT (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -26.18%) BELOW TREND and ETHA (1W: -9.73% | 1M: -37.07%) BELOW TREND; monitor XLK (1W: +3.51% | 1M: -2.60%) RECOVERY for confirmation of tech strength.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +18.64%) ABOVE TREND; Materials — XLB (1W: +3.33% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Technology — Technology (sector breadth: 1W: -0.24% | 1M: -7.31%) and Financials (sector breadth: 1W: -1.03% | 1M: -1.17%) showing weakness; watch for tech breadth to catch up with XLK.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Gold — GLD (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +10.75%) ABOVE TREND and Brent — BNO (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +10.63%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Natural gas — UNG (1W: -8.47% | 1M: +10.20%) CORRECTION and Silver — SLV (1W: -3.31% | 1M: -0.87%) BELOW TREND until momentum stabilizes.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (complacency gauge), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health), GLD 10%+ one‑month gains as a threshold for sustained safe‑haven demand, XLK/XLF pivot (~2.0 ratio) to watch for style shift.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, supporting market stability but risk indicators are mixed. Energy and materials (XLE, XLB) and gold (GLD) showing strength while crypto (IBIT, ETHA) and tech breadth are key divergences to monitor.
